clause: Masking system — mask sources (manual/geometric + range) via StudioMask [STU-RAW-014a]

scope.summary: Implement develop local-adjustment masking through the canonical StudioMask primitive (the same masking primitive used by 14.4/14.9, NOT a raw-only mask type): manual/geometric sources (Linear gradient with optional bidirectional flip; Radial gradient oval inside/outside with feather; Brush with Size/Feather/Flow/Density/Auto-Mask color confinement) and range sources (Color range with multi-sample + Refine/breadth slider usable as intersect refinement; Luminance range with Select-Luminance slider + luminance-map view; Depth range using embedded depth data with Select-Depth slider + depth-map view). AI sources are the separate optional adapter of MT-426.
acceptance_criteria: manual/geometric + range mask sources on canonical StudioMask; Argus + manual
expected_tests: test: linear/radial/brush + color/luminance/depth range sources build StudioMask (no forked mask type)

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Masking — sources

risk_if_missed: No local masking; forked raw-only mask type (dedup violation).

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
